Our analysis

Of the 43 saloons in our comparison, the BMW M3 Competition is the 6th most expensive to own.

Its biggest cost is depreciation: €60,966 over 5 years, 66% of the total.

At a real consumption of 10.4 L/100 km, every 100 km costs about €18.43 in fuel.

FAQ

How much does a BMW M3 Competition cost per month?

About €1,534 a month at 15,000 km a year over 5 years, including depreciation, energy, insurance, servicing and road tax. That's €1.227 per km.

Which DGT label does the BMW M3 Competition have?

The C label.
